sermon.title: What Does the Baptism of the Holy Spirit Have to Do with This?
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In this message Pastor David G. Kincer calls the baptism of the Holy Ghost the third promise that brings us into the divine nature, a baptism of power he says is for today. Using Luke 24, Acts 1 and 2, Ezekiel 36 and John 14, he says the Comforter is Jesus coming back in spirit, and that this promise is for all flesh with no respect of persons. He then separates the gifts of the Spirit from the fruit and shares an experience about tongues.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added by hand, and obvious caption errors were corrected; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor note: when he says the Joel 2:28 promise is fulfilled in “Acts 21:16,” the passage that quotes Joel is Acts 2:16-18. He says “Apollos prophesied that a famine would come”; the famine prophecy is by Agabus in Acts 11:28, and Acts 6 names Stephen among those who served the widows (the captions spell it “Steven”). He says the new covenant is found in “Hebrews 6 and 8” and Jeremiah; the new covenant passage is Hebrews 8 (quoting Jeremiah 31). The transcript keeps his words as spoken. He quotes 2 Chronicles 19:7, Acts 17:30, John 16:8, 1 Corinthians 14 and John 4:24 without naming the references. The captions garble a few words, shown as [unclear]. He opens by calling this the third promise that brings us into the divine nature and refers back to earlier lessons on the first two divine natures of Christ. He names a real person (President Obama) and speaks about homosexuals, drug and alcohol use, tithing, the Pope, Pentecostals, fundamentalists and charismatics, and says he has led “over 50” homosexuals to Christ with over 30 still serving; these are his own claims and remarks, kept as spoken and not checked here. He also tells of a personal experience in which he says God spoke to him about tongues.

chunks.section_question: Is the baptism of the Holy Spirit for today?
chunks.short_answer: He says the baptism of the Holy Ghost is the promise of the Father, a baptism of power or spiritual ability, and that Peter said the promise is to you, your children and all who are afar off. chunks.section_question: Who is the other Comforter in John 14?
chunks.short_answer: He reads John 14:16 that the Father will give another Comforter, and says the first Comforter is Jesus and the other is the Spirit of truth who abides forever, so there is no time when it stops. He says Jesus was with them and would be in them, and that when we quarrel over the Holy Ghost we are quarreling over Jesus.
chunks.text:
How many will raise your hand and say, “Jesus, I want to be like you. My goal is to be like you. Not like the pope, not like the preacher, but like you. Yeah, that was it was a cry in my heart as a young Christian. And we used to sing this song to be like Jesus. All I asked is to be like him. So meek and lowly, sweet and holy. All I ask that was a real cry for me. I wanted not to be just your everyday Christian, the shooting star talking about God on fire one day and and then three months goes by and you’re back to your old life. I wanted to grow and be like that song meant a lot to me. And we should have that desire because the Holy Ghost puts it in us. Now John 14:16 the father shall give you another comforter.

Okay. Another comforter. Then who is the first comforter? Can you guess who the other comforter is? Jesus. Who’s there? Jesus is a comforter, but he’s going to send another comforter. Do you guys ever look at the word like this? See, that’s why you need teachers. See, they need to stir up our thinking. Are you with me? So, there was a previous comforter and obviously it’s who? Jesus Christ. But there’s another one coming. Now, watch this. Watch this closely. This is powerful. That this comforter may abide with you how long?

Forever. That gets rid of dispensationalism right there. There’s not a time where the comforter is going to be with us, the baptism of the Holy Ghost, and then it’s going to stop. It’s going to be here how long? Forever. You, your children, and to those a far off. This is a forever thing. Are you with me? Hallelujah. Even the spirit of truth. Now, who is the truth, the way, and the life? Jesus. Jesus is that spirit of truth. God is a God of truth and God is a spirit. God is that spirit of truth. Jesus is that spirit of truth. You can’t separate these three. And yet God uses the terminology so we can understand them.

Now, how long is he going to abide with us? Forever. Okay. And he’s a spirit of truth. You know, if you go around lying, don’t tell me you’re filled with the Holy Ghost. His first name is Holy. He’s a Holy Spirit. He’s a Holy Ghost, which means spirit. And he’s a Holy Spirit of truth. You got your opinions. Your opinions may not be truths at all. Don’t tell me the Holy Ghost tells you things when it’s not truth because he is the spirit of truth. Amen. Jesus is truth. Now watch this. Are you ready?

You know him. Know who? The spirit of truth. The comforter. Now, who did they know at this point? Jesus. They didn’t know the Holy Ghost. They didn’t know anything about the Holy Ghost. I’ll show you that in a minute. They had no idea about this Holy Ghost. But he says, “You know him. You know him. He dwells with you.” Who is dwelling and living with them? Jesus. Jesus is living with them. Amen. Now, he is with you and shall be what?

In you. And that’s what Ezekiel said. This new spirit, God’s spirit, the spirit of Christ is going to be in us. So Jesus was with them. But when he died in that fleshly body or he he laid down his life in that fleshly body, he picked it up again and he ascended into heaven with that fleshly body void of blood, a non-deing body. Then he came back as the comforter who is the what? Holy Ghost. Wow. So when we quarrel over the Holy Ghost, we’re quarreling over Jesus. We’re fighting about Jesus. And we’re fighting stupid battles, foolish battles.

And this is why we need to get this word out. American Christians need to grow up. And I’ve been telling a lot of people in the last three years, you need to grow up. You need to get out of the baby stage. You need to get out of the children’s stage. You need to get into the young men’s stage of growth. You need to get with a program. Hallelujah. They get mad at me and everything else, but it doesn’t matter. They really need to grow up. I have to tell my kids, it’s time to grow up. There’s a time to grow up. Jesus is going to come back as the comforter and be in us. And when we say he’s not involved anymore because there was a dispensation back there where there was a Holy Ghost poured out and tongues and all this stuff happened, but now it’s not going on.

No miracles, no. You’re telling me that Jesus is not active in the church. And I’m telling you, you’re a liar. He is active in his church. He is the one that builds the church. Amen. He is the Holy Ghost. He is God. God is Jesus. God is the Holy Ghost.

Are you there? And when we fight over these things, we’re fighting over Jesus. And we need to stop fighting over Jesus and get Jesus and all of his aspects. Could that be an amen? The promised spirit of Jesus can still change us if we repent. All we got to do is admit we’re wrong. Admit our doctrine’s wrong. Admit our belief is wrong. Admit our opinions are wrong. Admit our sin is wrong. Ask Jesus to forgive and cleanse it. He will. And then you turn from it and you may stumble and go back but you get up, you repent. That is the divine nature that God has given us to keep getting up from sin’s death and destruction and getting life.

That’s the divine nature. That’s why Christians are in a growth process. Galatians 6:7 in closing, don’t be deceived. God is not mocked. Whatsoever a man sows, so shall he reap. If he sows of the flesh, he will reap corruption. If he sows to the spirit, he will reap life everlasting. God isn’t going to be mocked. That’s why he is no respector of persons. President Obama, the homeless man on the street, all have to repent. Summing it up, God promised, his third promise is the Holy Ghost. The Holy Ghost would be within us pouring out of us fruits that show change.

scriptures.text_nkjv: My little children, these things I write to you, so that you may not sin. And if anyone sins, we have an Advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous.

Do not be deceived, God is not mocked; for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap. For he who sows to his flesh will of the flesh reap corruption, but he who sows to the Spirit will of the Spirit reap everlasting life.

faqs.question: Why does he say we should stop arguing about the baptism of the Holy Ghost?
faqs.answer: He says if the baptism has to do with the divine nature, then we need to quit arguing about it, quit dividing over it and quit fighting about it, and participate in it.

scriptures.text_nkjv: that the blessing of Abraham might come upon the Gentiles in Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

faqs.question: What does the word "cause" mean in Ezekiel 36:27?
faqs.answer: He says it means God will trigger and move us and be an active force in us, so it isn’t us just trying to discipline ourselves to obey. He says he needed that as a young Christian and as an old one.

scriptures.text_nkjv: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you; I will take the heart of stone out of your flesh and give you a heart of flesh. I will put My Spirit within you and cause you to walk in My statutes, and you will keep My judgments and do them.

faqs.question: What does he say about still needing to be cleansed after being saved?
faqs.answer: He says that as a young Christian he found out he had many wrongs in him once the light shined, and that the Holy Ghost puts that spirit in us and burns it out like fire.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then you shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; you shall be My people, and I will be your God. I will deliver you from all your uncleannesses. I will call for the grain and multiply it, and bring no famine upon you. And I will multiply the fruit of your trees and the increase of your fields, so that you need never again bear the reproach of famine among the nations.

faqs.question: Does he say Jesus is the Comforter who comes?
faqs.answer: He says Jesus promised not to leave us comfortless and said "I will come to you," so the Comforter that was coming is Jesus himself coming back in spirit form, while his body is in the heavenlies.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And I will pray the Father, and He will give you another Helper, that He may abide with you forever— the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it neither sees Him nor knows Him; but you know Him, for He dwells with you and will be in you. I will not leave you orphans; I will come to you.

faqs.question: What does he say the name Emmanuel proves?
faqs.answer: He says Emmanuel means God with us, so Jesus was God in the flesh, and God himself came and died on the cross in a human body called Jesus Christ the Messiah.

faqs.question: What does he say about books on interpreting dreams?
faqs.answer: He says to stop reading books on how to interpret dreams, because the Holy Ghost gives you a dream, he’ll give you the interpretation.

faqs.question: What does he say about cliques in the church?
faqs.answer: He says the church has cliques after church and before church where people of the same type hang together, but Jesus bonded with everyone and was no respecter of persons.

faqs.question: What does he say about paying tithes?
faqs.answer: He says you pay your tithes because God said to so the message could get out, and that if a church is not getting the message out or teaching the truth, you should ask why you are paying your tithes there.

faqs.question: What does he say about asking God to find a spouse?
faqs.answer: He says you can’t bribe God into finding you a spouse, and that if you act like a virtuous man or woman you are liable to wind up with one, while the Bible says marry whom you think is best.

faqs.question: Does he say there is a different Bible for different cultures?
faqs.answer: He says there is no Spanish Bible, African Bible or women’s or men’s Bible; this book is forever and there is one book for all.

faqs.question: What does he say about joy and peace as fruit of the Spirit?
faqs.answer: He says Christians in America don’t have joy, and they only smile when everything goes their way, unlike Peter who could smile in prison and sleep in perfect peace the night before his death.

scriptures.text_nkjv: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control. Against such there is no law.

faqs.question: What does he say a spouse or parent needs more than gifts?
faqs.answer: He says a good wife or husband needs a spouse who is turned into a different person, not one who can prophesy, and that his kids want a dad, not a bell-ringing message.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then the Spirit of the LORD will come upon you, and you will prophesy with them and be turned into another man.

faqs.question: What does he say the divine nature means for a Christian who stumbles?
faqs.answer: He says we admit we are wrong, ask Jesus to forgive and cleanse, and turn from it, and that if you stumble you get up and repent again, which is the divine nature that keeps us getting up and getting life.
